actions.note: Guarantee HQ view before touching any build actions — returns to HQ if in world, no-ops if already in HQ

actions.log_success: Finish Now found — claiming free finish
actions.log_skip: No Finish Now — checking for speed-up prompt

actions.log_success: Building finished — looping to check for more
actions.note: Step 4 flow: confirms the free finish, then skips straight past the Back step to the final wait so the loop restarts without also trying to start a new build this pass.

actions.log_success: Initiate Build found — starting a new build/upgrade
actions.log_skip: No Initiate Build — checking for speed-up prompt

actions.log_found: Speed-up prompt found with no Initiate Build available — nothing left to build for free (not tapping, verification only)
actions.log_skip: No speed-up prompt either — nothing to do this pass
actions.note: Presence check only — does not tap btn_speed_up. skip_to_on_found just points at the next step so it continues normally either way.

actions.log_success: Building help requested — skipping back-out, looping directly
actions.note: When this tap succeeds we're already in a state where the back-out chain isn't needed — skip straight to the final wait so the loop restarts from step 1.

Speed-up-only case: close the purchase dialog first. Does NOT end the task here — that only removes this one popup, the building detail panel underneath is still open, so the next two steps back out of it properly before finishing.

actions.log_success: Only speed-up available, no Initiate Build — backed out and ending the loop
actions.log_skip: No back button found after closing purchase dialog — already at HQ, ending the loop anyway
actions.note: Speed-up-only exit condition: ends the task once we've confirmed nothing free to build this pass, whether or not a back button was found (closing btn_exit_purchase sometimes already returns straight to HQ with no panel left to back out of).

actions.log_success: Nothing to build and no speed-up prompt either — backed out and ending the loop
actions.log_skip: No back button found and nothing to build this pass — ending the loop anyway
actions.note: Nothing-found exit condition: neither an initiate-build icon nor a speed-up prompt appeared this pass (e.g. all build queues already occupied) — ends the task instead of burning through max_loop_iterations doing nothing.

actions.log_skip: No back button found — could not back out to HQ view
actions.note: Step 12: back out to HQ view before the loop restarts (a build was initiated this pass — keep looping in case another building is idle)
